New exact opt-in: STRATA_PHASE_PREFILL_12K=1 with --prefill 12288,
STRATA_PHASE_DECODE_CACHE=1, STRATA_PHASE_HEAD_LEASE=1,
STRATA_PREFILL_SCRATCH_ALIAS=1. Flags absent/0/01/etc remain OFF.
Existing fixed8192 default behavior is retained. 12K is rejected without explicit
lease+alias, with auto/another capacity, or with incompatible unchanged phase envelope.
Raw option guard runs before generic pipeline/auto normalization and before model/device
allocation; explicitly requested pipeline1 cannot become pipeline0 and silently qualify.
Later actual admission retains every existing safe predicate: singleGPU/serve/noMTP,
noBorrow/batch0/rawpipeline0/noReuse/HostUSM/nativeDQbatch1/segmented1/deviceplan0/
residentgraph0/int8 resident32768/full logical context262144 and cache/profile rules.
BF16X2 and separately owned KV stage are rejected for12K. Integer --prefill and existing
--vram-reserve-mib parsing now rejects overflow/trailing junk before allocation.
No new reserve option; positive existing operator reserve is required (default700MiB).

Single frozen admitted capacity is passed to every fresh-GEN Prefill init; leased startup
is deferred until first GEN, so this also covers actual initial allocation. Every reinit
checks configured and actual capacity. No silent8K fallback or mixed capacities.
Actual chunk callback logs count/position and uses subtraction-safe full-context checks.
Existing full-context diagnostic endpoint and generation reserve handling are preserved;
no new tokens[n] read or zero-output successor path was introduced.

Lease retains original source type/dims/conversion metadata, drains/retires all reader
graphs, releases head weights/scratch across entire Prefill run AND reset, then validates
and reloads the original source before new graph capture/decode. No VRAM-to-RAM head
copy, no persistent GDN/KV/PLE/session drop. Verifier capture refuses leased head.
Unknown completion and uncertain maps retain existing fail-stop/owner-retention contract.
Short verifier reads are excluded while leased; cancellation/nonfinite/nan_flush fail closed.
All lease changes inherited from H, with no runtime proof newly added here.

Alias sizing/count/carve/owned/borrowed/relayout uses one process-frozen exact flag.
In-order compute required before allocations. FP32 y, normalizer and math unchanged.
Allocator checks aligned take multiplication/addition and cumulative used before allocation;
borrow cap subtraction is checked. 12K paths validate narrow fixed model geometry plus
full mode1/int8 state/page extents before count/init, bounding stride/route/kernel products
on64-bit size_t; geometry bounds concern artifact shape, never GPU model identity.
Stock n_embd2560/hc4/lr320/GDN128x16x48/conv10240/y6144/QSA24x2x256/index4x128/
E512/FF640/K10/48layers and12QSA states admitted; pages65536/slots8192/full262144.
Existing expert group is clamped1..64, ring bounded, MMQ shape formulas derive stock dims.
Unsupported geometry, separate stage, cap changes and arithmetic overflow fail before
head release; allocation/launch extents are not inferred from a B570 head byte figure.

Requested memory evidence:
Prefill::phase_capacity_estimate uses actual bytes_needed and active GDN/QSA/MoE functions,
counts mode1stage using same takes, tokens and identity separately. It is recomputed with
FINAL group/ring/pinned-share settings before every head release; early count is validation
only. After release and extra detach/drain, fresh SYCL device free must cover workspace+
tokens+identity+conditional chooser+conditional lazy GEMM+existing operator reserve.
Stage is explicitly insideworkspace, not double-counted. Existing mappings/persistentstate/
verifier allocations already reduce freshfree. Free sample is not a reservation or fit proof.
Logs retain requested counts, each shared competitor, actual max, conditionalbounds,
operator reserve, actualfree, configuredcap and actualrunT; physical_fit_proof=0.
Conditional chooser bound includes capacityT*48*128*4 plus3MiB state unless explicit serial
heads or keyhead0 excludes it. At12K yy288MiB and state3MiB. Lane eligibility alone does not
remove reserve, because runtime chooser fallback may occur. Conditional lazy GEMM uses
actual device FP16-only matrix capability and BF16TC setting, max shape of all resident
BF16 weight refs (conservative including unused), plus fixed32MiB input slice. Size bounds
and sum overflow checked. Lazy costs can therefore overestimate selected projections.
JIT/backend/provider/fragmentation has no exact source-safe physical bound; existing
operator reserve is a pending bounded admission guard, NOT invented physical peak proof.
Operator may tune --vram-reserve-mib for hardware; insufficient free fails clearly at12K.

For R356/R381 stock compact fallback, BF16X2off, context262144, aliasON at12K, source
formula yields GDN1469056768B, QSA1634831104B, MoE1631505920B: QSA actual winner.
Aliased8K-to12K workspace growth1067171840B, plus16384B tokens. This is recomputed
count arithmetic, not interpolation or physical measurement. R381 unaliased baseline
1227554816B +16384B token growth is preserved as a distinct source ledger.
Mode1stage276825088B fixed, identity262144B separate. Runtime logs decide actual active
route counts; no hardcoded total or head byte size is used for admission.
